title: Blast radius and rollback for corvane-commons 3.0 (Jakarta)
area: Safe change on monoliths and shared libraries
scenario: The platform team wants corvane-commons 3.0 on Jakarta EE 10, dropping 2.x, with an irreversible DDL on a 410-million-row audit table that every consumer runs at startup. Seven consumers depend on it in different ways, from EAP 7.4 WARs to a .NET API and SQL extracts. The board wants your blast radius and rollout plan first.
task: Build the blast-radius table across consumers, DB objects, REST/JSON, JMS and pipelines
Sequence the change with parallel change and dual publishing of javax and jakarta artifacts
Give a detection method per risk and a rollback per step, including the DDL
Define go/no-go gates and push back where ARCH-212 is unsafe
acceptance: Every consumer and shared asset has a concrete impact
Every consumer stays deployable at every step; the plan fits the calendar
Detection and rollback for each risk and step

practices.label: Week 7 - blast radius and parallel change on a shared library
